description.narrative: The MFA supports activities that inform and engage the Danish public in international development cooperation and the global South. The media Reelly will inform and engage Danes between 13-29 in the Global South and Danish development cooperation through journalistic social media productions, educational materials, events and partnerships.

owner-org.narrative: Denmark - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Danida
Denmark - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Danida

tag.narrative: Enhance international support for implementing effective and targeted capacity-building in developing countries to support national plans to implement all the Sustainable Development Goals, including through North-South, South-South and triangular cooperation

title.narrative: Reelly has continued to report from all continents, including countries on the DAC list, to ensure broad coverage. Reellys content has been viewed 2.5 million times. Cumulative number of views. Reellys stories have reached 2 million unique accounts (reach). Reellys average views per story are 60,000 on TikTok and 15,000 on Instagram.
Increases in reach and engagement are measured using Metas and TikToks business suites. In addition, we track how many continents have actually been reached.

Reelly continues to engage young people from DAC countries, who share their stories with viewers through Reellys POV storytelling method. Reelly continues to innovate ways to give people in DAC countries a voice in journalism.
Reelly tracks the number of stories featuring people from DAC countries who share their stories.
In order to scale up our efforts and thereby increase the impact of Reellys work, it is essential that Reellys financial foundation becomes more robust and sustainable.
Reellys financial sustainability is measured by the media outlets revenue, revenue sources, and plans for these.

Reellys stories reach a wide audience through external platforms and partnerships. Reelly works consistently to give young people in DAC countries a relevant and engaging voice in the Danish media landscape.

Analysis shows that more people in the target group are being exposed to Reellys stories about conditions and people in DAC countries. Reelly has launched initiatives to increase exposure to its content through external partners, thereby strengthening awareness and engagement among Danish youth. In addition, new methods have been developed for disseminating and telling stories about sources from DAC countries.

target.value:
Reelly continues its positive development in building relationships with relevant distribution partners and increasing its exposure through these collaborations.
Reelly continues its positive work in producing targeted POV portraits from DAC countries for its target audience.

title.narrative: Danish young people are exposed to Reellys journalism and engage with it, especially when Reelly reaches out to young people who would not seek out this kind of information on their own. This is achieved through content tailored to the target audience, which is based on constructive and critical, visually compelling narratives about life in the Global South and topics that connect Danish young people to these issues.
Analyses and data show that Reelly reaches and engages Danish youth with stories that increase understanding of living conditions in DAC countries.

target.value: Reelly continues to engage and inform its target audience through tailored, balanced, critical, and constructive stories from DAC countries, delivered through its news influencer explainer formats and POV portraits.

title.narrative: Financial sustainability is measured by performance across Reellys four revenue streams.

target.value:
Reelly's new board is constituted and contributes to Reelly's strategies and methods within the four revenue streams.
Reelly has sought inspiration from or collaboration with other organizations that have succeeded with partnerships and alternative sources of income that create a robust financial foundation.
Reelly has applied to major international foundations such as the Melinda Gates Foundation and explored the possibility of applying for EU funding related to editorial content, where relevant to the applications.
Reelly has applied for grants from major Danish foundations.
Reelly has increased revenue within areas including video production, teaching, and presentations.
Reelly has increased revenue as a partner/consultant/producer.
Reelly has developed and explored a membership strategy for civil society organizations.
